lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular matrix of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in horizontal rows and vertical columns posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal spot alignments, forming a grid-like pattern of anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple parallel linear features running horizontally along the upper third of the flank, defined by a high-contrast transition from light-reflective upper edges to shadowed lower margins.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple elongated, low-luminance silhouettes (likely remoras) positioned ventrally and posterior to the pectoral fin.
